requirements.statement: A customer can complete an authorized password reset that changes their account password to a newly selected password.
acceptance_criteria: Given a customer is able to complete an authorized password reset for their account, when they complete the reset with a new password, then the account password is changed to the new password.

requirements.statement: The sign-in page displays a "Forgot password?" link.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sign-in page is displayed, when a customer views it, then a "Forgot password?" link is available.

requirements.statement: Activating the "Forgot password?" link starts the password reset request flow.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sign-in page shows the "Forgot password?" link, when a customer activates it, then the customer can begin a password reset request.

requirements.statement: The response to a password reset request is identical whether the requested account exists or does not exist.
acceptance_criteria: Given equivalent password reset requests differing only in whether the account exists, when each request is submitted under the same applicable conditions, then their customer-visible responses are identical.

requirements.statement: Password reset requests are limited to five per account per hour.
acceptance_criteria: Given five password reset requests for an account have been permitted in a one-hour period, when another request for that account is submitted within that period, then it is not permitted as an additional reset request and the account-existence-neutral response requirement still applies.

requirements.statement: Each reset link can complete no more than one password reset.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reset link has been used to complete a reset, when it is used again, then it cannot complete another reset.

requirements.statement: Reset links expire 30 minutes after issuance.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reset link was issued 30 minutes ago, when it is used to attempt a reset, then it cannot complete that reset because it has expired.

requirements.statement: Completing a password reset signs the account out of every active session.
acceptance_criteria: Given an account has active sessions, when its password reset completes, then none of those sessions remains signed in to that account.

requirements.statement: The account owner is notified after every successful password reset.
acceptance_criteria: Given an account owner has completed a successful password reset, when the reset completes, then a notification of that reset is sent to that account owner; each subsequent successful reset also produces its own notification.
